operations.title: 1256 — Exact Cyclic Symmetry Forbids a Physical Rank-Three Five-Resultant Slice
operations.body: The Entry 1234 cone orbit has sum_i P_i=(0,0,5), squared norm 25, so it violates global momentum conservation. More generally, a real 3D C5 orbit is 1+2; conservation removes the invariant line and forces Gram rank≤2. Therefore no exact C5-symmetric conserved rank-3 five-resultant slice exists in d=3. Entries 1235–1244 are retyped as algebraic-slice results.

operations.title: Benincasa retracts physical status of the cyclic five-site slice
operations.body: Entry 1256 exposes a physical-typing defect: Entry 1234’s P_k=(cos,sin,1) obey sum P_k=(0,0,5), so the loop resultants violate momentum conservation. This is structural: any real d=3 C5 orbit is 1⊕2; conservation kills the invariant line, forcing Gram rank≤2. Hence an exact C5, conserved, rank-3 five-resultant slice is impossible. Entries 1235–1244 remain exact only on a nonphysical algebraic family; 1251/1253/1254 retain abstract representation content but not physical-period reduction. The replacement physical slice must break C5 and recompute Landau support.

authority_basis.summary: Repairing the physical-typing defect exposed while continuing the user-directed five-site cosmology lane
